first-timer.title: A ger on the steppe near Mandalgovi
first-timer.alt: A white canvas ger stands alone on dry, open steppe under a wide blue sky with scattered cloud.
first-timer.author: Mark Fischer

naadam.title: Wrestling at Naadam in Ulaanbaatar
naadam.alt: Pairs of Mongolian wrestlers in traditional boots and vests grapple on a stadium field while robed attendants stand nearby.
naadam.author: Bernard Gagnon

gobi.title: The dunes of Khongoryn Els
gobi.alt: Tall pale sand dunes stretch across the desert floor beneath a range of bare grey mountains.
gobi.author: Bernard Gagnon

ger.title: Inside a family ger
ger.alt: A woman feeds a stove inside a ger, with painted orange furniture, roof poles and a basket of firewood around her.
ger.author: Al Jazeera English

orkhon.title: Erdene Zuu Monastery, Kharkhorin
orkhon.alt: Brick temple gateways with curved tiled roofs and red-painted walls inside the grounds of Erdene Zuu Monastery.
orkhon.author: Bernard Gagnon

khovsgol.title: The shore of Lake Khövsgöl
khovsgol.alt: Clear blue water of Lake Khövsgöl laps a stony shore with driftwood, with forested hills on the far side.
khovsgol.author: Bernard Gagnon

eagle.title: A Kazakh eagle hunter in Bayan-Ölgii
eagle.alt: A Kazakh man in an embroidered skullcap sits beside a golden eagle perched on his gloved arm.
eagle.author: Ceyhun Kavakci

itinerary.title: The Flaming Cliffs at Bayanzag
itinerary.alt: Red-orange sandstone cliffs and eroded gullies drop away to a flat desert plain.
itinerary.author: Richard Mortel

horses.title: Riders on the steppe near Kharkhorin
horses.alt: Two riders, one in a yellow robe, ride across green steppe leading a spare horse, with grassy hills behind.
horses.author: Marcin Konsek

packing.title: Winter by a frozen river
packing.alt: Snow and ice cover a riverbank lined with bare trees, with larch forest on the hillside behind.
packing.author: Dembee Tsogoo

ulaanbaatar.title: Sükhbaatar Square, Ulaanbaatar
ulaanbaatar.alt: The broad paved expanse of Sükhbaatar Square with the red-and-white opera house and modern towers beyond.
ulaanbaatar.author: Bernard Gagnon

altai.title: Potanin Glacier, Altai Tavan Bogd
altai.alt: A long glacier winds between snow-covered peaks under heavy grey cloud in the Altai mountains.
altai.author: Mongolia Expeditions… (Panoramio user)

nomad-life.title: A herder in the Orkhon Valley
nomad-life.alt: A herder on horseback carrying a long pole drives a flock of goats across a green valley floor.
nomad-life.author: Sergio Tittarini from Shanghai, China

horses-adventure.title: Riders driving a flock across the steppe
horses-adventure.alt: Two distant riders move a long line of sheep and goats across wide brown steppe below rolling hills.
horses-adventure.author: Jeanne Menj

travel-tips.title: A van on a steppe track in Khentii
travel-tips.alt: A grey off-road van drives along a dirt track across green steppe, with a river and gers in the distance.
travel-tips.author: GerritR
